title: ART-MPG: Autoregressive R/T Manifold Path Guiding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Specular chains concentrate important transport in small regions of path space and the structure depends on chain topology. We introduce ART-MPG, a compact neural model that samples chain length, an autoregressive reflection/transmission (R/T) string, and a direction from a topology-conditioned four-component von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mixture. We extend the repeated trial weighting in Manifold Path Guiding (MPG) by conditioning retry sampling on both chain length and the sampled R/T string, accounting for its known mass outside the stochastic re-hit trials. For a fixed proposal and target chain, this preserves the ideal expectation while reducing the expected retry count and reciprocal-estimator variance compared with retries conditioned on chain length alone. translated_title: ART-MPG：自回归反射/透射流形路径引导
translated_abstract: 镜面链将重要的光传输集中在路径空间的小区域内，其结构取决于链的拓扑。我们提出了ART-MPG，一个紧凑的神经模型，它对链长度、自回归的反射/透射（R/T）字符串进行采样，并从以拓扑为条件的四分量von Mises-Fisher（vMF）混合分布中采样方向。我们扩展了流形路径引导（MPG）中的重复试验加权方法，将重试采样同时以链长度和采样的R/T字符串为条件，并考虑了其在随机重命中试验之外已知的概率质量。对于固定的提议分布和目标链，与仅以链长度为条件的重试相比，该方法在保持理想期望的同时，降低了预期重试次数和倒数估计器的方差。我们将形式上的无偏性结果与实验中使用的带封顶和钳位处理的渲染器区分开来。我们在十四个场景上、在一系列每像素采样数（SPP）设置下进行评估（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出ART-MPG，一种通过自回归采样镜面链的长度与反射/透射拓扑字符串、并以拓扑条件化vMF混合分布采样方向，同时将重试采样同时条件化于链长度和R/T字符串的紧凑神经模型，在保持无偏性的前提下降低了流形路径引导的预期重试次数和估计器方差。
en_tdlr: ART-MPG is a compact neural model that autoregressively samples specular chain length and R/T topology string with topology-conditioned vMF direction sampling, extending Manifold Path Guiding's retry weighting to be conditioned on both chain length and R/T string, thereby reducing expected retry count and reciprocal-estimator variance while preserving unbiasedness.
